visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a brown ribbed tank top, stands in a brightly lit indoor room. She smiles at the camera, gesturing with her hands as she holds three SHILLS sunscreen products. The background is a soft-focus beige wall with a lamp. (2) The scene shifts slightly as she holds a smartphone with a UV camera attachment. She then applies a cream to her right cheek. A small inset window appears showing her face through the UV lens; the area with cream turns solid black on her skin. (3) She holds a different sunscreen bottle and applies it to her left cheek. In the UV inset window, this side appears white and mottled rather than black, indicating poor UV protection. She points to the stark contrast on her face to demonstrate the difference. (4) She picks up a white tissue and forcefully rubs both cheeks. On the right side, the black UV layer remains mostly intact, while on the left side, the competitor's white layer is completely wiped away, as visible in the UV camera inset. (5) She uses a small spray bottle to mist water onto her face. She wipes again with a tissue. The UV camera view demonstrates that the right side maintains its protective dark coating, showing no significant streaks or removal from moisture. (6) She picks up two white spray cans. She shakes one and sprays a fine mist over her face and neck. The UV camera view shows the mist instantly creating a dark, even layer of protection over her skin, forehead, and ears. (7) She performs another wipe test with a tissue on the sprayed area. The black UV layer remains unchanged. She then sprays water again and wipes, with the UV camera showing high durability of the sunscreen spray coating on her face. (8) She demonstrates the spray can's functionality by tilting it upside down and spraying. She then holds up all three SHILLS products together, smiling brightly. The video ends with a logo screen featuring the text SHILLS in pink letters.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, high-tempo pop music begins playing. A female voice speaks with a friendly, energetic tone and moderate pace. Her articulation is clear and professional. The background has a clean studio silence floor with no audible environmental noise. (2) A sharp, digital pop sound effect triggers as a UI element appears visually. The speaker's pitch rises in an excited reaction. The BGM maintains a steady beat with prominent electronic synth textures and a clear percussive drum kit foundation. (3) The vocal tone shifts to a more skeptical, questioning prosody with a falling intonation pattern as she discusses a competitor. Another pop SFX occurs. The BGM continues unchanged in the background with a high arousal level. (4) A distinct, textured rustling sound of a tissue is heard as she wipes her face. This is an incidental noise with moderate intensity. The vocal delivery remains high-arousal and energetic, narrating the results with high confidence. (5) A sharp, hissing sound of a water spray bottle occurs twice in quick succession. This is followed by a slight splashing liquid sound. The BGM rhythm remains synchronized with the quick-cut editing. The speaker continues her high-energy commentary. (6) A loud, continuous pressurized hissing sound from an aerosol spray can dominates the audio mix for several seconds. The speaker reacts with a high-pitched exclamation. The BGM swells slightly in volume, maintaining a strong, driving rhythmic pulse. (7) Another round of tissue rustling and water spray sounds are heard. The vocal intensity remains high, with frequent rising pitch contours indicating excitement. The music maintains its energetic, bright spectral weight and consistent percussive beat. (8) The music builds in intensity with a more complex harmonic structure. The speaker concludes with a triumphant tone. A final digital ding sound effect coincides with the final brand logo appearance before the audio track concludes.
